projects.name: stream-deployer
projects.description: Automated deployment, configuration, and lifecycle orchestration tool for Spring Cloud Data Flow streams. Simplifies complex data streaming pipelines with programmatic verification, configuration management, and robust deployment automation.

projects.name: design-by-contract
projects.description: Kotlin Multiplatform Library that provides functions to enforce Design by Contract concepts like preconditions, postconditions and invariants.

projects.name: kfsm
projects.description: KFSM is a Kotlin Multiplatform Library that provides a DSL for defining Finite State Machines and executing using an immutable configuration.

projects.name: kfsm-viz
projects.description: KFSM-VIZ is a Kotlin Library for generating PlantUML and/or Mermaid diagrams from KFSM definitions as well as Asciidoctor file with State Table from KFSM DSL.

projects.name: kfsm-viz-plugin
projects.description: This is a Gradle plugin that will generate PlantUML and/or Mermaid diagrams from KFSM definitions as well as Asciidoctor file with State Table.

projects.name: More in Development
projects.description: Additional architectural patterns, test helpers, and streaming connectors derived from real-world consulting engagements at infosmid.com are continuously evaluated and packaged for public release.
